name: Capital One Venture X Business Credit Card

loungeAccess.network: Capital One Lounge Network + Priority Pass
otherLounges: Capital One Lounges (Dallas DFW, Denver DEN, Washington Dulles IAD, and growing)
Unlimited Priority Pass Select membership with unlimited complimentary guests
loungeAccess.notes: Cardholder and 2 authorized users each get their own Priority Pass memberships. Priority Pass allows unlimited visits with unlimited guests. Capital One Lounge: complimentary access for cardholder.

tripDelay.notes: Trip delay reimbursement of up to $500 per ticket. Triggers after a 6-hour delay or an overnight delay.

tripCancellation.notes: Trip cancellation/interruption reimbursement up to $2,000 per trip. Must pay for common carrier tickets with the card.

lostBaggage.notes: Lost luggage reimbursement up to $3,000 per passenger.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Travel accident insurance up to $250,000 for accidental death or dismemberment while traveling as a passenger on a common carrier.

emergencyMedical.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services available. Does not cover medical or evacuation costs directly.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Primary auto rental collision damage waiver via Visa Infinite. Decline the rental company's CDW. Covers rental vehicles up to the actual cash value.

otherCredits.name: Annual Travel Credit
otherCredits.notes: $300 annual credit for bookings made through the Capital One Travel portal. Effectively reduces net annual fee to $95.

otherCredits.name: 10,000 Anniversary Bonus Miles
otherCredits.notes: Receive 10,000 bonus miles every year on your account anniversary (worth ~$100 in travel).

rewards.travelRate: 10x miles on hotels and car rentals booked through Capital One Travel; 5x on flights booked through Capital One Travel
otherBonusCategories: 10x miles on hotels booked through Capital One Travel
10x miles on rental cars booked through Capital One Travel
5x miles on flights booked through Capital One Travel
2x miles on all other purchases — no category restrictions

pointValue.transferPartners: Transfer to 15+ airline and hotel partners at 1:1 ratio (Air Canada Aeroplan, Avianca LifeMiles, Flying Blue, Turkish Miles&Smiles, etc.). Miles also redeemable at 1 cent each as statement credit for travel purchases.
